findings.title: Account suspension
findings.root_cause: Ordinary profile UPDATE could clear deleted_at; private policies and privileged persistence trusted a still-valid session.
findings.after: Active-profile checks at the server, restrictive RLS, column grants, active role helpers and locked persistence wrappers deny disabled/missing status.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PASS for bounded real JWT and local-app/real-backend scenarios: active, already-issued suspended session, fresh suspended sign-in, denied self-reactivation, restored access.

findings.title: Canonical bookmark identity
findings.root_cause: Adapter required a relational lessons.id while the published pilot is a governed item with no relational lesson row.
findings.after: Add a constrained stable governance UUID target and owner-checked canonical RPCs; preserve legacy references and confirm writes before UI success. Shared eligibility also enforces a linked relational lesson/module when present.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PASS: live canonical save, duplicate, fresh sign-in/browser persistence, owner-only removal and cross-user denials in both rounds.
findings.remaining_limitation: Hosted deployment remains pending; only task-created bookmarks were removed.

findings.title: Historical assessment versions
findings.root_cause: A completed old-version attempt could be paired with current questions and feedback.
findings.after: Separate historical service verifies owned completed attempt, exact installed version and immutable content snapshot/hash. No current fallback, rescore or awards on review.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PARTIAL: two genuine v2 assessment submissions, immutable repeated reviews and cross-owner denial passed.
findings.remaining_limitation: Real original v1 archive remains missing; no substitution or historical repair.

findings.title: Backend-mode consistency
findings.root_cause: Authentication could select Supabase while other adapters selected local fixtures in mixed configuration.
findings.after: All adapters use one validated getBackendMode decision. Mixed/live local mode is rejected; missing live configuration never enables fixtures. Local UI identifies temporary test data.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PASS within the tested local production app against staging: normal mode, controlled backend transport failure, no fake save/identity, recovery.
findings.remaining_limitation: Remote build/runtime still require deployment and verification.

findings.title: Author workspace honesty
findings.root_cause: Supabase author loader returned unavailable but UI represented an empty workspace and overstated operations.
findings.after: Surface unavailable state and explicitly defer editing/submission; use the honest-deferred alternative accepted in 53E.
findings.local_verification: Source inspection confirms explicit unavailable/deferred UI; live author CRUD is not implemented or claimed
findings.live_verification: PASS for direct ordinary JWT draft ownership and role boundaries; frontend honestly defers author editing/submission.
findings.remaining_limitation: Live author UI CRUD remains deferred under the accepted scope.

findings.title: Privileged simulation publication
findings.root_cause: Service-role lookup bypassed RLS and trusted publication labels without exact evidence/version and eligible parents.
findings.after: Exact-version service resolver and locked persistence guards intersect independent publication evidence and parent eligibility, including retries and withdrawal.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PARTIAL: existing named legacy simulations exist for staff and are hidden from both students; local exact-publication transaction tests pass.
findings.remaining_limitation: No eligible standalone simulation supports a live positive launch or withdrawal test.

findings.title: Complete private library state
findings.origin: New library projection of capped summary queries
findings.root_cause: The library treated records outside the recent dashboard window as absent.
findings.after: Dedicated library queries retrieve all pages with deterministic cursors and fail honestly on incomplete data; dashboard retains its bounded recent view.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PASS: both real-backend library/dashboard journeys and durable result/progress presentation; local 135-record pagination regressions remain valid.

findings.title: Account status input validation
findings.root_cause: Unknown operation was converted to enable.
findings.after: Reject missing/unknown operation before invoking the manager RPC; retain explicit enable and disable.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PASS: synthetic manager disable/restore through ordinary JWT; strict action input checks remain locally verified.
findings.remaining_limitation: No real person was disabled or modified.

findings.title: Withdrawn bookmark removal
findings.root_cause: Deletion shared current content eligibility lookup, preventing owner removal after withdrawal.
findings.after: Owner may delete an existing bookmark by its ID without obtaining withdrawn metadata. Lists return a generic unavailable item; reopening remains publication-gated.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
findings.live_verification: PARTIAL: ordinary removal verified twice; withdrawn-item behavior remains locally verified only.
findings.remaining_limitation: No real pilot withdrawal or new technical publication was authorized/performed.

findings.title: Private account transition

findings.root_cause: Shell changed account while old server-rendered body and saved state remained visible.
findings.after: Shared identity scope binds environment, profile and roles to every rendered payload. Synchronous hiding, generation checks, cancellation and full reload on identity mismatch discard stale private state; same-context delayed identity and delayed RSC tests cover return navigation.
findings.local_verification: PASS: both complete local passes qualified; see listed targeted regressions and per-test evidence
